dividend_events_amount_check.name: dividend_events_amount_check
dividend_events_amount_check.value: "dividend_events"."status" NOT IN ('declared', 'paid') OR "dividend_events"."gross_per_share_decimal" IS NOT NULL

dividend_manual_records_amount_mode_chec.name: dividend_manual_records_amount_mode_check
dividend_manual_records_amount_mode_chec.value:
(
          "dividend_manual_records"."shares_decimal" IS NOT NULL
          AND "dividend_manual_records"."dividend_per_share_decimal" IS NOT NULL
          AND "dividend_manual_records"."total_cash_decimal" IS NULL
          AND "dividend_manual_records"."total_franking_decimal" IS NULL
        )
        OR
        (
          "dividend_manual_records"."shares_decimal" IS NULL
          AND "dividend_manual_records"."dividend_per_share_decimal" IS NULL
          AND "dividend_manual_records"."franking_credit_per_share_decimal" IS NULL
          AND "dividend_manual_records"."total_cash_decimal" IS NOT NULL
        )

dividend_manual_records_fx_provenance_ch.name: dividend_manual_records_fx_provenance_check
dividend_manual_records_fx_provenance_ch.value:
("dividend_manual_records"."fx_rate_to_portfolio_decimal" IS NULL) = ("dividend_manual_records"."fx_rate_source" IS NULL)
        AND (
          "dividend_manual_records"."fx_rate_to_portfolio_decimal" IS NULL
          OR "dividend_manual_records"."currency_code" IS NOT NULL
        )

fx_rate_observations_scope_check.name: fx_rate_observations_scope_check
fx_rate_observations_scope_check.value: ("fx_rate_observations"."access_scope" = 'deployment' AND "fx_rate_observations"."scope_user_id" IS NULL AND "fx_rate_observations"."scope_key" = 'deployment') OR ("fx_rate_observations"."access_scope" = 'user' AND "fx_rate_observations"."scope_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "fx_rate_observations"."scope_key" = "fx_rate_observations"."scope_user_id")

manual_ledger_mutation_keys_target_check.name: manual_ledger_mutation_keys_target_check
manual_ledger_mutation_keys_target_check.value: ("manual_ledger_mutation_keys"."purpose" = 'create' AND "manual_ledger_mutation_keys"."target_transaction_id" IS NULL) OR ("manual_ledger_mutation_keys"."purpose" IN ('reverse', 'supersede') AND "manual_ledger_mutation_keys"."target_transaction_id" IS NOT NULL)

market_data_refresh_jobs_target_shape_ch.name: market_data_refresh_jobs_target_shape_check
market_data_refresh_jobs_target_shape_ch.value: ("market_data_refresh_jobs"."target_kind" = 'price' AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."mapping_id" IS NOT NULL AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."security_id" IS NOT NULL AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."base_currency_code" IS NULL AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."quote_currency_code" IS NULL) OR ("market_data_refresh_jobs"."target_kind" = 'fx' AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."mapping_id" IS NULL AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."security_id" IS NULL AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."base_currency_code" IS NOT NULL AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."quote_currency_code" IS NOT NULL AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."base_currency_code" <> "market_data_refresh_jobs"."quote_currency_code")

market_data_refresh_jobs_scope_check.name: market_data_refresh_jobs_scope_check
market_data_refresh_jobs_scope_check.value: ("market_data_refresh_jobs"."access_scope" = 'deployment' AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."scope_user_id" IS NULL AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."scope_key" = 'deployment') OR ("market_data_refresh_jobs"."access_scope" = 'user' AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."scope_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "market_data_refresh_jobs"."scope_key" = "market_data_refresh_jobs"."scope_user_id")

portfolio_securities_resolution_check.name: portfolio_securities_resolution_check
portfolio_securities_resolution_check.value: ("portfolio_securities"."status" = 'unresolved' AND "portfolio_securities"."security_id" IS NULL) OR ("portfolio_securities"."status" <> 'unresolved' AND "portfolio_securities"."security_id" IS NOT NULL)

portfolio_securities_relevant_dates_chec.name: portfolio_securities_relevant_dates_check
portfolio_securities_relevant_dates_chec.value: "portfolio_securities"."last_relevant_date" IS NULL OR "portfolio_securities"."first_relevant_date" IS NULL OR "portfolio_securities"."last_relevant_date" >= "portfolio_securities"."first_relevant_date"

price_observations_scope_check.name: price_observations_scope_check
price_observations_scope_check.value: ("price_observations"."access_scope" = 'deployment' AND "price_observations"."scope_user_id" IS NULL AND "price_observations"."scope_key" = 'deployment') OR ("price_observations"."access_scope" = 'user' AND "price_observations"."scope_user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "price_observations"."scope_key" = "price_observations"."scope_user_id")

securities_trade_dates_check.name: securities_trade_dates_check
securities_trade_dates_check.value: "securities"."last_trade_date" IS NULL OR "securities"."first_trade_date" IS NULL OR "securities"."last_trade_date" >= "securities"."first_trade_date"

watchlist_entries_shape_check.name: watchlist_entries_shape_check
watchlist_entries_shape_check.value:
("watchlist_entries"."kind" = 'security' AND "watchlist_entries"."security_id" IS NOT NULL AND "watchlist_entries"."base_currency_code" IS NULL AND "watchlist_entries"."quote_currency_code" IS NULL)
          OR ("watchlist_entries"."kind" = 'currency_pair' AND "watchlist_entries"."security_id" IS NULL AND "watchlist_entries"."base_currency_code" IS NOT NULL AND "watchlist_entries"."quote_currency_code" IS NOT NULL AND "watchlist_entries"."base_currency_code" <> "watchlist_entries"."quote_currency_code")
